description.value: Bici is a premium road, gravel, and mountain bike retailer on Adanac Street in Vancouver, carrying top-tier brands such as Specialized, Trek, Cannondale, Santa Cruz, and Cervelo alongside apparel from Rapha, MAAP, and ASSOS. It operates a dedicated service department and is part of a multi-location BC chain with shops in Victoria and Langford. Touring cyclists will find a broad on-bike accessories section including bags, racks, fenders, lights, and tires, making it a well-stocked resource stop in the city.
